message.content: LiHua created an opportunity for Chae to meet Wolfgang and Yuriko through introducing them as friends. In one of their conversations, LiHua mentions, "Hey guys! Just wanted to introduce you both since I think you'll hit it off! Yuriko, this is Wolfgang, my best buddy. Wolfgang, meet Yuriko, an amazing speech therapist with her own studio." This introduction led to Wolfgang and Yuriko knowing Chae, and LiHua encouraged them to plan a jam session together, suggesting, "Absolutely! I'm down for a jam session! I love making music with others. Just let me know when you want to get together! 🎶😊". This interaction highlights LiHua's efforts to bring Wolfgang, Yuriko, and Chae closer together through shared musical activities.
